question: Does excluding the farther capture pass reduce doubled house walls?

training.internal_evaluation: enabled on each arm train split only; eval_all=true; external eval and guard RGB excluded

near.timingScope: Process wall time including final evaluation on that arm training images; not held-out metrics.

far.timingScope: Process wall time including final evaluation on that arm training images; not held-out metrics.

both.timingScope: Process wall time including final evaluation on that arm training images; not held-out metrics.

assessment.conclusion: Both passes give the best overall result in this short house screen. Closer-only does not cure ghosted edges and deteriorates more toward the other path; farther-only is softer. None demonstrates clean, freely explorable walls.
assessment.doubleWallFinding: No clean duplicated-wall elimination demonstrated. The tree-occluded target facade is recognizable in all arms, but transparent facade/roof edges persist. A discrete second wall plane cannot be reliably localized from these clips alone.
assessment.scope: One white bungalow and adjacent frontage, not a full street/block.

review.actualPlayback: Both synchronized12s clips played at2304x480,30fps without decode error. Actual1152x648 native PNGs also inspected.

assessment.rankingScope: AI-assisted editorial visual screening of one house and these views. Not an accuracy percentage or an overall algorithm rank.
assessment.formula: round(100 * visualPoints /65); five unsupported efficiency/runtime categories remain null.

near.summary: Second overall. Recognizable, locally sharp facade, but road shadows stretch into dark sheets toward the farther path. Foliage and some building edges remain translucent.

far.summary: Third overall. Softer facade, porch and road boundaries; broad shadow/foliage smears remain. Dropping the closer pass does not produce clean walls.

both.summary: Best overall here. More continuous road/sidewalk and useful facade appearance across the tested corridor. Roof edges, foliage and adjacent facade still flare or ghost.

assessment.nextTest: Re-solve this house per pass and inspect distributed roof/window/porch landmarks before retraining. Test joint rigid-rig refinement with validated lens calibration. Keep both-pass observation coverage unless corrected-pose evidence supports removing a pass.
